data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model returned an inconclusive verdict because of HTTP 400 API errors when attempting to review the PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO files. learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for LLM API calls to prevent coverage gaps caused by transient HTTP errors.
